purpose: Checked-in review memory for Vulkan execution-plan, canary, and topology decisions that are not shape-admission rows.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 evidence row; behavior is generic stream-sync cleanup, not a GPU dispatch predicate.
entries.candidate: Reset idle persistent external-recording command and descriptor pools after successful stream synchronize.
entries.decision: Keep the stream-sync cleanup fix. It removes the repeated-run stack-overflow failure without broad Context::flush() recovery.
revisit_conditions: If persistent external-recording pool ownership changes.
If stream synchronization stops being the public benchmark boundary.
If another GPU shows idle-pool reset causes correctness or lifetime regressions.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 canary measurement; not a production default and not a model-name route.
entries.candidate: Use segmented stack-owned external recording for the wide4 bridge canary after stream-sync pool cleanup.
entries.decision: Keep as an opt-in canary and current best measured bridge lane. A follow-up 3-repeat sweep after the pool-reset fix measured wide4 ahead of wide3 and the prefix-tail modes for device-resident vits_140 timing. Do not promote without multi-GPU and multi-row stability.
revisit_conditions: After multi-scope ownership proof is repeat-stable.
After DAv2 vits_182 and non-DAv2 corpus rows show no stack overflow, device loss, or capture drift.
After contract/graph counters show no hidden fallback, readback, or extra copy regression.
If a longer repeat-count run or another GPU contradicts the 3-repeat segment-mode sweep.

entries.head: 316300434e0
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 evidence row; failure is tied to repeated context-owned bridge topology, not a model-name route.
entries.candidate: Use the stack-output device bridge repeatedly without a stack-owned segmented recording mode.

correctness.reason: A one-repeat context-owned bridge run passes bridge sanity, but repeated three-forward runs exit with Windows stack overflow -1073741571 before writing a result artifact.

entries.decision: Do not use repeated context-owned stack-output bridge timing as a performance lane. Use a bounded segmented stack-owned recording mode for repeated bridge benchmarks.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit after the context-owned bridge repeat stack overflow has a root-cause fix.
Require a repeated no-stack-owned-mode run to complete with bridge sanity, cpu_fallback=0, and sync_readback=0.
Do not compare context-owned bridge timings against segmented modes while the repeated context-owned run exits with -1073741571.

entries.head: post_f443b6fd49d_guard_cl
entries.device_notes: Benchmark control-plane guard; not a backend route or GPU dispatch predicate.
entries.candidate: Fail repeated context-owned stack-output bridge benchmark runs before native execution unless a bounded segmented stack-owned recording mode is requested.
entries.decision: Keep the benchmark guard so repeated bridge timing cannot rediscover the context-owned stack-overflow path by crashing Python.
revisit_conditions: Only remove the guard after a repeated context-owned bridge run completes without stack overflow and has bridge sanity, cpu_fallback=0, and sync_readback=0.
Keep one-repeat bridge sanity allowed for local diagnostics.
Keep bounded segmented stack-owned modes allowed for performance canaries.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 measurement; result may become an autotune candidate on other devices.
entries.decision: Do not make 16x8 the static default for this shader on the RX 9070 vits_140 lane.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit under a device/driver-keyed VulkanConvPlan autotune experiment.
Only revisit if the 3x3 shader implementation changes enough to invalidate this workgroup comparison.
Do not rerun as another static default proposal for the same shader and device evidence.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.candidate: Fuse decoder-tail ReLU into the existing conv context clamp path.
entries.decision: Keep the separate decoder-tail ReLU/clamp path for this lane; the conv-clamp fusion is correct but slower.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit if Conv2dContext clamp execution changes.
Only revisit if a transition-contract budget shows the separate ReLU path introduces a new copy, readback, or submit cost.
Do not repeat as a local decoder-tail fusion for the same baseline.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.device_notes: Not device-specific; blocked before performance measurement.
contract_or_topology_scope: Depth Anything V2 fused head candidate
entries.candidate: Enable the existing fused Depth Anything V2 head shader path.

correctness.reason: The fused head path is explicitly disabled because it is not numerically aligned with the reference DPT head across supported decoder shapes.

entries.decision: Do not enable or benchmark this path until a correctness matrix proves it.
revisit_conditions: Add CPU, generic Vulkan, and fused-head parity for representative vits/vitb/vitl decoder shapes.
Include non-square lower-bound resize rows and align_corners=True coverage.
Only then create a region-fusion performance entry.

entries.head: 49f93e81e81
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 scratch run; uses existing compiled-session/replay bridge guards.
entries.candidate: Force the DAv2 benchmark through the compiled-session/replay bridge shortcut.

correctness.reason: Scratch run exited with Windows stack overflow -1073741571 before a valid timing result.

entries.decision: Keep the compiled-session/replay bridge guard. Do not use this as a DAv2 shortcut.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit after replay/compiled-session ownership has a non-recursive planned region implementation.
Require a stack-overflow-free repeated vits_140 run before considering timings.
Require guard metadata to prove no replay-hit recursion or unsafe fallback path.

entries.head: aa8bcfd
entries.device_notes: Architecture-level result; model row was evidence provenance.
entries.candidate: Delete one current-topology phase-boundary submit after barrier and ownership proof accepted.

correctness.reason: Stress testing exposed intermittent private-capture corruption even when ownership and barrier proof looked complete.

entries.decision: Do not pursue current-topology submit deletion. Move to planned region-owned or segmented recording instead.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit if the current topology is replaced by a region-owned command-buffer domain.
Require value-preservation proof plus stress parity across repeated private-capture outputs.
Do not revive retire-time or local lifetime-only phase-submit coalescing.
